name: Noclip
description: Experimental hidden wave trajectory prediction for press/release correction.

window-frames.name: Timing window (frames)
window-frames.description: Maximum allowed early input offset, in game simulation steps. Default: 5. Set 0 to disable delay.

auto-learn.name: Learn inputs that survive
auto-learn.description: Saves input timing positions after surviving at least 12 simulation steps. This does not prove an input was perfect.

record-reference.name: Record reference timing (training)
record-reference.description: When on, delay is disabled and EVERY click/release is saved as a reference for the current level. Turn OFF after a clean practice run.

blind-delay.name: Delay unlearned inputs too (experimental)
blind-delay.description: When on, unfamiliar presses/releases are delayed by the full frame window. This IS NOT selective and may make timings worse.

platformer.name: Enable in platformer levels (experimental)
platformer.description: Platformer speed and direction changes can make timing anchors unreliable.

clear-learned.name: Clear all timing references
clear-learned.description: Toggle ON to permanently clear saved reference timings. Turn OFF again to resume learning.

predict-wave.name: Hidden wave trajectory correction (experimental)
predict-wave.description: Predict safe wave press/release timings without drawing the trajectory.
